semantics.how: Drops invented files, keeps the first assignment of duplicates and puts unmentioned files in an unclustered fallback
semantics.what: Repairs a proposed clustering into a strict partition of the real files
semantics.where: Interpreter: validation of clusters and traced flows
semantics.why: Guarantees every real file appears exactly once

semantics.how: Combines modularity, giniImbalance, cluster count and largest share into one record
semantics.what: Measures a partition's modularity, count, size distribution and imbalance
semantics.when: Used in tests and quality reports
semantics.where: Interpreter: validation of clusters and traced flows
semantics.why: Makes clustering regressions show up as changed numbers

semantics.what: Builds a baseline clustering where each file joins its parent directory
semantics.when: Used as a comparison baseline for clustering quality
semantics.where: Interpreter: validation of clusters and traced flows

semantics.how: Sorts sizes and applies the Gini formula scaled to the range 0 to 1, returning 0 for a single cluster
semantics.what: Computes a normalised Gini coefficient over cluster sizes
semantics.where: Interpreter: validation of clusters and traced flows
semantics.why: Measures how uneven cluster sizes are

semantics.how: Sums the weight of edges whose endpoints share a cluster and divides by the total
semantics.what: Scores the fraction of edge weight inside clusters
semantics.when: Used by clusteringQuality and baseline comparison
semantics.where: Interpreter: validation of clusters and traced flows
semantics.why: Cheap cohesion measure for comparing partitions

semantics.how: Splits on case and separators, joins with underscores and drops one trailing banned token unless it is the only token
semantics.what: Canonicalises a cluster name to snake case
semantics.when: Applied to proposed cluster and group names
semantics.where: Interpreter: validation of clusters and traced flows
semantics.why: Keeps names stable across runs that vary case and suffixes

semantics.how: Builds an adjacency map of known units and recursively keeps the longest branch with a per-branch visited set, returning null for unknown entries
semantics.what: Traces an API flow's steps from an entry unit along real call edges
semantics.where: Interpreter: validation of clusters and traced flows
semantics.why: Every step is a validated graph edge, so steps cannot be hallucinated

semantics.how: Recurses into each unvisited callee and keeps the longest resulting path
semantics.what: Returns the longest call chain starting at one unit
semantics.where: Interpreter: validation of clusters and traced flows
semantics.why: Picks one linear branch so steps stay a list, not a tree

semantics.how: Builds a tree over outgoing call edges capped by fan-out and depth, carrying edge labels and a per-branch visited set
semantics.what: Traces every branch of an API flow from its entry unit
semantics.when: Called when building branching flow steps
semantics.where: Interpreter: validation of clusters and traced flows
semantics.why: Preserves conditional fan-out without unbounded growth

semantics.how: Recurses into up to the maximum fan-out of unvisited callees until the depth cap
semantics.what: Builds the branch tree node for one unit
semantics.where: Interpreter: validation of clusters and traced flows
semantics.why: Bounds tree size while keeping branch labels
